Run an RRP assessment and retain its history

Source: R/rrp-run.R
rrp_run.Rd

Run the configured project source mapper at one analytical time, determine which discharge episodes remain eligible for first readmission in the remaining 30-day follow-up window, and call the project risk provider once per eligible episode. Accepted estimates, provider failures, and ineligible outcomes are retained together as one completed run.

Usage

rrp_run(path, as_of_time)

Arguments

path

Path to an existing RRP project with initialized analytical state.

as_of_time

One finite UTC POSIXct analytical instant. This same time is used for source production, eligibility, provider requests, and history.

Value

An ordinary list with run_id, as_of_time, episodes_processed, accepted, provider_failures, and ineligible. Counts are integers; the run ID belongs to a successfully committed run.

Details

Call rrp_state_init() before the first run. The project owner must implement the configured rrp_produce_canonical() and rrp_calculate_risk() functions. A provider failure affects its episode, while a source or persistence failure stops the run without a partial completed record. Inspect retained rows with rrp_inspect_history() and generate analytical products separately with rrp_refresh_products().

Examples

project <- tempfile("rrp-run-")
rrp_project_init(project, "example-rrp")
time <- as.POSIXct("2026-01-10 12:00:00", tz = "UTC")
episode <- data.frame(
  episode_id = "episode-1", patient_id = "patient-1",
  index_encounter_id = "encounter-1",
  admission_time = time - 2 * 86400, discharge_time = time - 86400
)
events <- data.frame(
  terminal_event_id = character(), episode_id = character(),
  event_type = character(), occurred_at = time[FALSE],
  available_at = time[FALSE]
)
saveRDS(list(discharge_episode = episode, terminal_event = events),
        file.path(project, "canonical.rds"))
# Replace both generated stubs; this constant risk is illustrative only.
writeLines(
  c("rrp_produce_canonical <- function(project_root, as_of_time) {",
    "  readRDS(file.path(project_root, 'canonical.rds'))", "}"),
  file.path(project, "R", "produce-canonical.R")
)
writeLines(
  "rrp_calculate_risk <- function(project_root, request) list(probability = 0.2)",
  file.path(project, "R", "calculate-risk.R")
)
rrp_state_init(project)
